summary: Request for on-site document shredding and secure disposal service
description: Issue summary: Facilities team received a request from Finance to schedule a certified on-site document shredding service for 5 boxes of archived HR records containing PII. Requested outcome: Book a certified vendor for secure on-site shredding between Mar 8-12, obtain certificate of destruction, and confirm chain-of-custody procedures for audit trail.
impact: Accumulating archived boxes containing PII in storage; audit teams will expect documented disposal for compliance. Low immediate operational impact but medium compliance risk if not handled before quarter-end audit.
